title: System Engineer (Network & Integrated Building Systems) | $3500 to $5500 #5252
bullet: Be capable of working independently and contributing effectively as part of a project team.
ad:
Job Responsibilities:
• Design, configure and maintain network infrastructure supporting Building Management Systems (BMS), Energy Management Systems (EMS), and Fault Management Systems (FMS)

• Install, configure, test and troubleshoot servers, network devices and system applications

• Support integration between IT networks, building systems and operational technology

• Monitor network and system performance, availability and security

• Support project implementation, system migration, testing and commissioning

• Troubleshoot network, server and application issues

• Coordinate with vendors, contractors and internal stakeholders

• Prepare technical documentation including network diagrams, test plans and operating procedures

• Perform preventive maintenance, system upgrades and patch management

• Ensure compliance with IT, cybersecurity and operational standards

Job Requirements:
• Diploma or Degree in Computer Engineering, IT, Electronics Engineering or related field

• Experience in network engineering, system administration or infrastructure support

• Experience with BMS, EMS, FMS, SCADA or IoT systems will be an advantage

• Knowledge of TCP/IP, VLAN, routing, switching, firewalls and VPN

• Familiarity with Windows Server, Linux and virtualization will be an advantage

• Knowledge of BACnet, Modbus, OPC, MQTT or SNMP will be an advantage

• Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills

• Good communication and stakeholder management skills

• Able to work independently and as part of a project team

• CCNA, CCNP, Network+, ITIL or relevant certifications will be an advantage

title: Network Engineer Graduate Program
bullet: Obtain industry-recognized certifications to enhance professional credentials.
ad:
Job Description

At Nokia, we create technology that helps the world act together. Network Infrastructure (NI) provides the essential building blocks of modern communications networks, powering innovation in cloud, AI, automation, broadband, data centers, and secure networking.

As part of our commitment to developing future talent, we are investing in the next generation of engineers through the Network Engineer Graduate Program.

How You Will Contribute And What You Will Learn

Why Join This Program?

• Structured Learning: Guided pathways covering network fundamentals, automation, cloud, AI/ML, IP technologies, security, and software development.
• Hands-On Experience: Labs, simulations, network design/troubleshooting, automation projects with Agentic AI, and real customer projects.
• Mentorship & Coaching: Regular sessions with technical experts and business leaders, plus peer learning.
• Certifications: Industry-recognized certifications sponsored by Nokia.
• Cross-Functional Exposure: Job rotations across multiple teams and functions.
• Long-Term Growth: Potential for permanent placement in Nokia's Network Infrastructure organization based on interest, strengths, and business needs.

Your Journey

Phase 1: Learning & Development (First 6 Months)

A structured program of self-paced learning, instructor-led sessions, and hands-on activities covering network automation, cloud, AI/ML, and internet technologies. You'll build programming fundamentals (Python, REST APIs, JSON), learn security and performance monitoring, earn certifications, and strengthen communication and presentation skills through mentoring, technical challenges, and knowledge-sharing sessions.

Phase 2: Job Rotations (Next 12 Months)

Up to two rotations across areas such as Network Integration, Customer Solution Design, Automation & Digitalization, Project Management, Customer Engineering, Service Delivery, or Network Transformation Programs — working on real projects alongside experienced engineers and cross-functional teams.

Key Skills And Experience

• What We Are Looking For
• Recent Bachelor's/Master's graduates or final-year students
• Curiosity, learning agility, and passion for technology
• Interest in automation, AI, cloud, networking, or software development
• Strong problem-solving, communication (English), and teamwork skills
• Self-driven, adaptable, and proactive

Preferred (not required): exposure to computer networking, Python, cloud technologies, automation, APIs, data analytics, or AI/ML through coursework, internships, or personal projects.

• What You Will Gain
• A strong foundation in modern networking technologies
• Practical experience in automation, cloud, and AI
• Industry-recognized certifications
• Real-world project experience and cross-Nokia networking
• Multiple job rotations and accelerated career growth
• Ready to Start Your Journey?

If you're a self-driven learner who enjoys exploring new technologies and solving challenging problems, we'd love to hear from you. Join Nokia and help shape the future of connected networks.
